messages:
anya_cs: Hi everyone, I'm Anya — starting as CS this week. Getting blocked on Gainsight and Gong access. Gainsight says 'no product access' and Gong throws SSO error. Who should I ping?

evan-ops: welcome @anya_cs! Tagging here so we keep it public. Did you complete the account request in the onboarding checklist?

anya_cs: I filled the checklist but maybe missed a dropdown for 'Customer Success' product bundle.

evan-ops: ok I'll create the provisioning ticket. @it-helpdesk-bot can you open ticket for Gainsight + Gong + Slack channel add? role=CS, repo access sales-cs-collateral

it-helpdesk-bot: Ticket created: IT-2489 — "Provision: Gainsight, Gong, #cs-playbooks for anya_cs". ETA assignment: 3 hours. Link: https://tickets.redwood.internal/IT-2489

anya_cs: thanks. Also where's the CS onboarding one-pager and success plan templates?

evan-ops: Templates are in the drive: /sales/cs/templates. Quick link: https://redwood.example.com/cs/templates (internal). There's a '30-60-90 Success Plan' and an 'Onboarding Call Checklist'.

training-bot: New hire training reminder: "CS Quickstart" cohort starts Friday 10:00 PT. Recommended: review success plan template before cohort.

anya_cs: great, please add me to the cohort.

evan-ops: added you. IT update: assigned to rachel-ops-admin. They'll confirm once licenses applied.

it-helpdesk-bot: IT-2489 status: In progress. Gainsight license applied pending role mapping. Gong provisioning blocked by SSO cert mismatch, escalated to SSO team.

anya_cs: ah — anything I can do for the SSO cert mismatch?

evan-ops: No action needed from you; SSO team will handle cert. Meanwhile, you can review customer playbooks and shadow renewals calls in the recordings folder.

it-helpdesk-bot: IT-2489 update: Gainsight active with 'CS-Standard' role. Gong SSO fixed by infra; invite resent. Slack channel #cs-playbooks created and invite sent. Closed by rachel-ops-admin at 2026-03-23T17:40:20Z.

anya_cs: I can access Gainsight now and I got the Gong invite — can join calls. Thanks folks!

evan-ops: Awesome. Ping in #cs-playbooks if you want a 1:1 walkthrough of the success plan template. Welcome to the team! :tada:

training-bot: Welcome DM sent to anya_cs with key links and calendar invites: https://cal.com/redwood/cs-30
